desc:
You're one survivor, and you control your arms yourself. Swing a bat, a crowbar or a machete with your mouse: aim for the head, and how hard you hit is how hard you swing. Zombies break apart where you hit them. Cut off a leg and it will crawl after you.

GUNS
- Pistol, pump shotgun and a fully automatic M16
- Real reloads: swap magazines, load shells one at a time, fill magazines from boxes of ammo


THE ZOMBIES
- They hear gunshots and breaking glass and come to find you
- They bang on doors and windows until they break, then climb in
- Hit them while they're climbing or getting up and they go down
- Every few minutes a horde comes

THE SANDBOX
Press P to spawn zombies, get any weapon or ammo, send a horde, and fix every door and window.

Controls: Mouse to look, hold left mouse to swing or shoot, right mouse to aim, R reload, Tab backpack.

Still in development. More weapons coming!
